headline: Alexander Acosta Announces Resignation as Labor Secretary

info.description: 2019-07-19: In accordance with his resignation announcement, Alexander Acosta stepped down one week later on the 19th.
info.note: Deputy Labor Secretary Patrick Pizzella stepped in to take over as acting head of the department.
